findings.scenario: After readline and the interrupted check, SIGTERM can arrive while parsing the request or checking the deadline. The signal handler only sets interrupted and execution still reaches Popen; the target can perform side effects before the subsequent cleanup. Similarly, after the launch request is consumed, caller death and pipe EOF are not checked again before Popen. The existing SIGTERM test waits until the target starts and does not exercise this window. This is a source-derived race, not a reproduced failure.
findings.remediation: Design and verify a launch/cancellation handshake that prevents launch when cancellation or caller loss wins the gate, with deterministic tests covering interruption and caller death at the boundary; retain fail-closed terminal evidence.
